title: GDD T-108 — Sequencer: cuotas, anti-repetición y bias anti-frustración (§9.2, §6.4)
description: Extend the existing Sequencer (TASK-005 era) into the GDD §9.2 selector: seeded draw over the active MicrogamePool (v2 definitions from TASK-030) respecting hard constraints — per-7-round session quota (>=1 asymmetric, exactly 1 coop special phase, rest competitive), never the same mechanic two rounds in a row, never the same variant twice per session, plus the §6.4 anti-frustration bias: if a player placed 4th two consecutive rounds, the third round's draw is biased toward a mechanic from that player's best in-session history (bias of SELECTION, never of result). The GDD nesting prohibition applies: one decision -> at most one random draw. The whole selector is a pure function of (seed, history) — fully testable. Applies difficulty ramp D(r) = 1 + 0.06(r−1) metadata to the selected definition (final microgame D=1.5 fixed). Read GDD §9, §6.4 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Selector is a pure function of (seed, session history): same inputs -> same draw (replay test); no hidden state, no wall clock
Quota test over 1000 seeded 7-round sessions: every session has >=1 asymmetric, exactly 1 coop special, remainder competitive
Anti-repetition: no mechanic twice consecutively and no variant twice per session, verified over the same 1000-session corpus

Anti-frustration bias engages exactly on the two-consecutive-4th-places trigger and provably shifts selection probability toward the player's best-history mechanic without guaranteeing outcome (statistical test)
D(r) ramp attached per round with D_final = 1.5 for the climax microgame
Existing Sequencer consumers keep compiling; tests-first; fast suite green after, no regression

comments.author: developer-cloud
comments.body: [developer-cloud] TASK-035 delivered on branch claude/gdd-hito1-cloud, tests-first. 11d3bfc test(core): failing spec, red = CS0234/CS0246 on Barcade.Core.Sequencer.V2 types (11 tests, all 6 ACs). Impl commit follows (Sequencer/V2: MicrogameSelector static pure class + RoundRecord/RoundSelection PODs). Suite 471 -> 482 green, zero regressions; the 1000-session quota/anti-rep corpus and the 2000-trial bias statistical test are part of the suite. Design notes for reviewer: (1) v1 SequencerDirector untouched — same v1/v2 coexistence rationale as the v2 IMicrogame contract; the v1 pick loop re-rolls (nested randomness) so it was not extended in place. (2) Quota implemented via scheduled windows: coop round = 3|4 (single draw, dedicated stream, GDD 7.1), asym round = 5|6 (GDD 7.2 Jefe window); rest competitive — gives exactly-1 coop, exactly-1 asym (satisfies >=1), rest competitive. (3) One-decision-one-draw: constraint filtering is deterministic; the definition draw is a single weighted NextInt. (4) Bias weight x3 [ASSUMED] ('bias suave' has no GDD number; GameTuning candidate); bias restricted to the filtered candidate set so it never overrides anti-repeat; best-history = lowest place, ties -> most recent. (5) Relaxation order on unsatisfiable pools: dynamics quota -> mechanic-repeat -> variant-repeat (liveness; session never throws). (6) SelectFinalRound draws competitive-preferred at fixed D=1.5. (7) Seed derivation via mixed Combine(sessionSeed, stream) — will inherit PCG32 stream derivation when TASK-044 lands; probe-free tests stay valid.
